notes.title: 2022 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Golden Retrievers and welcome to our first development update! My brother and I have been having a great time developing the game this summer. The game has officially been in development for over a year now! We've been testing out new ideas and refining old ones. We think you'll be happy with the progress and we'd like to update you on the game. 

Where We Were Last Summer
Last summer was the very beginning of the games development. We had implemented and tested the initial concept of gameplay. We figured out what was fun, and what wasn't. Made modifications, and implemented features from the feedback we got. We took down the old demo and are currently working on the newer demo.

Golden Retriever Today!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40915573/a7fc05bb019d7197d7145f6a16672380dcbf165f.png

Updates and Improvements Made So Far:
Enemy Updates

 Dinos spawn from black sludge instead of randomly
 Waste bags will explode after a few minutes and create black sludge
 Dinos eat gold nuggets and gold coins


Processing Gold Mechanics

 Bags of Gold dirt turn into gold nuggets and must then be smelted into gold coins.
 Your washplant needs both gas and water to run.


Recycling Bin

 Gives you coal now when you insert waste dirt
 Can recycle Dino Prisoners for fossils
 Waste bags do not give you negative coins any longer


New Rent and Puppies Systems

 Fat Cat collects his rent from your ATM every month now.
 Puppies are born every month and require resources to grow.
 Puppies can become workers and soldiers.


Underground

 New block types
 New hazards
 Improved artwork


UI

 Changed Inventory system
 Changed layout of UI
 Added energy bar



We will only be posting major updates on the Steam hub. If you are interested in seeing more behind the scenes progress and gameplay, please follow us on  Twitter.  

Until next time and have a great remaining summer!

-Luke
